title: Garlic Prawns with Crisp Gnocchi
description: The gnocchi goes in dry and crisps like a potato. The prawns go in last.

confidence.note: No confidence note was recorded in the legacy card.

items.note: Roma or truss if you have them
For drawing water from the tomatoes

steps.text: Quarter the tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}), scoop out the seeds and watery pulp with your thumb, then cut into rough 2cm chunks. Toss with the salt ({{salt}}) and sit in a colander to drain 10 minutes. This is the step that keeps the pan from going watery.

Heat the cast iron over medium-high with the oil ({{oil}}). Add the gnocchi ({{gnocchi}}) straight from the packet in a single layer, no boiling. Leave it alone to catch colour, then toss and give it another few minutes until golden on two or three sides. Tip onto a plate.
Pat the tomatoes dry. Same pan, still medium-high, cut side down. Leave them until they collapse and start to catch, about 4 minutes, then push to one side.

Drop the heat to medium. Add the prawns ({{prawns}}) with all the sauce in one layer. Turn once. They are done when opaque and curled into a loose C. A tight O means overcooked. Pull the pan off the heat the moment they get there.

Off the heat, add the butter ({{butter}}), lemon juice ({{lemon}}) and chilli flakes ({{chilli}}). Swirl until the butter melts into the garlic sauce and goes glossy. Return the gnocchi and tomatoes, toss to coat, and scatter the parsley ({{parsley}}).

notes.title: Restored
notes.text: This card was in the August build and dropped out of later rebuilds. Restored unchanged from the August version.

notes.title: Butter off heat
notes.text: Adding it off the heat emulsifies the sauce. Straight into a hot pan it splits.

notes.title: Salt
notes.text: The bought garlic sauce is already seasoned. Hold the salt until you have tasted at the end.

notes.title: Draining the tomatoes
notes.text: Not optional. Skip it and the gnocchi loses its crust in the toss.
